print(f'COMMON_CONDITIONS={len(common)}; COMMON_INSTANCES={len(common)*len(counts)}')
print(f'NUMBERED_OBLIGATIONS={sum(counts)+len(common)*len(counts)} (not encoded node count; G4/#3 pending ruling)')
